home.seoTitle: Dar el Bacha — Moroccan fine dining restaurant in Casablanca
home.seoDescription: Dar el Bacha, a Moroccan fine dining restaurant in Casablanca: traditional cuisine, the art of hospitality, and table requests online or via WhatsApp.

hero.title: A grand house for Moroccan cuisine
hero.text: In Casablanca, Dar el Bacha serves Moroccan gastronomy with the care of a fine dining table: traditional recipes, carefully chosen produce, attentive service.

intro.title: An address in Casablanca
intro.text: Dar el Bacha brings together Morocco's culinary heritage and the precision of fine dining. Every visit is meant as an invitation: take your seat, let us look after you, and taste.

philosophy.title: Tradition as a starting point
philosophy.text: Moroccan recipes are passed down through gesture and patience. We serve them with the same respect, in a contemporary presentation that lets the produce speak.

signature.title: Signature dishes
signature.text: A selection from the menu, shown here once the dishes and their photographs have been approved by the restaurant.

experience.title: The time of a meal
experience.text: From your arrival to the end of the meal, every moment follows the rhythm of Moroccan hospitality: attentive, generous, never rushed.

cta.title: Book your table
cta.text: Send a request online or message us on WhatsApp. The restaurant confirms every reservation.

specialties.title: Flavours of the menu
specialties.text: A deliberately concise menu, built around the great classics of Moroccan cuisine.

items.boissons: Moroccan tea, infusions and fresh juices

histoire.seoTitle: Our story — Dar el Bacha, Casablanca
histoire.seoDescription: The identity of Dar el Bacha: traditional Moroccan cuisine, inherited know-how and the art of hospitality in Casablanca.
histoire.title: Our story
histoire.lead: A house devoted to Moroccan cuisine and the art of hospitality.

philosophie.title: Culinary philosophy
philosophie.text: Start from traditional recipes, choose produce with care, then plate each dish with the precision of fine dining.

inspiration.title: Moroccan inspiration
inspiration.text: Spices, slow cooking, almond and orange blossom sweets: Moroccan cuisine offers a remarkably rich repertoire, which the menu explores with restraint.

savoirFaire.title: Know-how and tradition
savoirFaire.text: Some preparations take hours. That time is part of the recipe, and we respect it.

recevoir.title: The art of hospitality
recevoir.text: In Morocco, welcoming guests is a way of honouring them. That sense of hospitality guides our service, from the first word to the last attention.

ambiance.title: The atmosphere
ambiance.text: Soft light, natural materials, crafted details: a setting designed so that the meal unfolds without haste.

confidentialite.seoDescription: How Dar el Bacha processes the personal data sent through the reservation request form, in accordance with Moroccan Law No. 09-08.
confidentialite.title: Privacy policy
confidentialite.lead: The data you entrust to us, how it is used and your rights.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.text: Personal data collected on this site is processed under the responsibility of:

data.title: Data collected
data.text: The site only collects personal data when you send a reservation request through the form:
data.item2: your email address and phone number;
data.item3: the requested date, time and number of guests;
data.item5: the language in which you browse the site.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.text: This data is used solely to process your reservation request and reply to you. It is neither used for marketing nor shared with third parties.

basis.title: Legal basis
basis.text: Processing is based on your consent, given by ticking the box provided before sending the form. Without this consent the request cannot be sent; you can always contact the restaurant by phone or WhatsApp.

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.text: Your data is intended for the restaurant. It passes through the following technical service providers, who only access it to provide their service:

transfers.title: Data location and transfers
transfers.text: Where the data is hosted and processed, and any transfers outside Morocco:

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: In accordance with Law No. 09-08 on the protection of individuals with regard to the processing of personal data, you have the right to access and rectify your data and, on legitimate grounds, to object to its processing. To exercise these rights, write to:

cndp.title: National Commission for the Control of Personal Data Protection (CNDP)
cndp.text: The formalities applicable with the CNDP are being verified by the restaurant; their reference will appear below. You may also lodge a complaint with the CNDP:

thirdParty.title: Third-party services
thirdParty.whatsapp: WhatsApp: the WhatsApp button opens a conversation with a pre-filled message that you send yourself; the exchange is then governed by WhatsApp’s terms.
thirdParty.maps: Google Maps: the access map is only loaded when you ask for it, by clicking “Show the interactive map”; Google then receives the usual technical data (IP address, browser).
thirdParty.booking: Online booking system: if offered, its module is only loaded when you ask for it and is governed by its provider’s terms.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: The site sets no cookies and uses no audience measurement tool. Should this change, this policy would be updated beforehand.

security.title: Security
security.text: Exchanges with the site are encrypted. Requests are not stored in a database on the site: they are sent to the restaurant by email. The reservation service’s technical logs contain no personal data; the hosting provider may however keep technical connection logs.
